subject.title: fix(agents): write unresumable notice to transcript for non-deliverable channels

question: Should WebChat unresumable restart recovery use a persistent delivery-mirror transcript row as the user-visible failure notice for this PR?
rationale: The code path is plausible and tested, but the permanent user-visible contract changes persisted session history and sits next to broader restart-recovery/no-retype design work.

options.title: Accept Guarded Transcript Fallback
options.body: Resolve the current merge conflict and land this PR if maintainers agree that WebChat should show the unresumable notice from the transcript.

options.title: Request WebChat UI Proof First
options.body: Ask for a short WebChat restart/reconnect proof before accepting the persistent transcript notice contract.

options.title: Defer To Broader Recovery Design
options.body: Pause this PR only if maintainers want the no-retype or SQLite restart-recovery route work to define the durable behavior first.

recommendation.title: Accept Guarded Transcript Fallback
recommendation.body: Resolve the current merge conflict and land this PR if maintainers agree that WebChat should show the unresumable notice from the transcript.
